dispositions.M1: Actual tools/call dispatch marker before req.end; every subsequent error becomes mcp_outcome_unknown/502, including post-response ACL, timeout and output rejection. Pre-dispatch stale catalog remains409. Injected fetch has explicit dispatch callback and regression.

dispositions.M3: Actual Bun1.3.14 client and isolated Node TLS fixture prove pinned target, preserved Host/SNI, one lookup, rejected wrong hostname and untrusted CA. Bun ignores proxy opt-out; therefore six proxy environment names fail closed before any DNS/socket request, including NO_PROXY=*.
dispositions.IPClassification: Standard and local NAT64 plus IPv4-compatible and mapped IPv6 ranges are rejected.
dispositions.MetadataGet: Project-scoped metadata-only get avoids listing all connectors for every revalidation.
dispositions.CredentialEcho: Decoded strings and object keys are checked, including quote/backslash credentials.
dispositions.MemoryStatus: All verification status changes require a human; scoped deletion remains unchanged.

remainingLimits: POST SSE responses must end within30seconds and fit512KiB before SDK delivery.
Already dispatched remote actions cannot be undone; uncertain outcomes must not be automatically repeated.
Arbitrarily transformed or partial secrets cannot generally be recognized.
Proxy-configured Hub environments cannot use project remote MCP on the pinned Bun release.

limits: Supported Evolved agent integrations: Claude and Codex. Older live processes must restart/resume once for the new gateway tools.
Remote public HTTPS443 StreamableHTTP only. No stdio/npx, private destinations, OAuth, remote sampling/roots/elicitation, redirects or automatic tool-call retries.
Completed POST response required within30s; a server keeping its SSE response open indefinitely times out.
Read-only is a human grant, not a guarantee of privacy or zero provider charges. Generic call uses ordinary agent approval policy, including user-selected unattended modes.
Disabling cannot undo externally started actions. Credentials are encrypted in isolated Vault; signed Hub resolves transiently.
MCP provider charges are not covered by HAPI memory budgets; no user provider keys used during validation.
On Bun1.3.14, a Hub with HTTP_PROXY/HTTPS_PROXY/ALL_PROXY (or lowercase variants) refuses remote MCP before networking. The Hub must have direct HTTPS egress.

opusFindings.decision: Fix both native Codex permission adapters so explicit MCP tool approval reaches policy handling before plain HAPI elicitation fallback.
Treat evolved_mcp_call as sensitive in read-only approval policy; preserve explicit user-selected unattended modes.
Separate pre-send denial from post-dispatch unknown outcomes; never recommend replaying an externally started operation. Record unknown status and prevent late journal resurrection after disconnect.
Key create-idempotency fingerprint with project-key HMAC; no plaintext-token password oracle in a stolen Vault database.

Passed actual Bun1.3.14 TLS tests for numerical destination, preserved Host/SNI and certificate validation. This Bun ignores proxy opt-out: reject all six nonempty proxy environment variables before DNS/network; do not mutate process environment.

followups: No new native per-server MCP endpoints or tools/list_changed dependency; four gateway tools deliberately keep dynamic project discovery centralized.
Fresh passkey remains required for connection changes, including disable, as the documented administration policy.
Deleted connection IDs remain tombstoned to prevent stale creation replay.
External tool content remains untrusted; arbitrary semantic prompt injection cannot be removed with string filtering.
